<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL"
                  xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance"
                  id="Definitions_USICourseRegistration"
                  targetNamespace="http://example.com/bpmn/usi-course-registration">
  <bpmn:collaboration id="Collaboration_USICourseRegistration">
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_USI" name="Sports institute" processRef="Process_USIRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:participant id="Participant_Twitter" name="Twitter"/>
    <bpmn:messageFlow id="MessageFlow_Tweet" name="Tweet to friends" sourceRef="Task_Tweet" targetRef="Participant_Twitter"/>
  </bpmn:collaboration>

  <bpmn:process id="Process_USIRegistration" name="New Application for Registering for an USI course" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:laneSet id="LaneSet_USIRegistration">
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_Applicant" name="Applicant">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Start_Registration</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_SlotsAvailable</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_NoSlots</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_SelectCourse</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AccountExists</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckEligibleUniversity</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_EligibleUniversity</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RegisterAccount</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_RequestActivation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_WaitForActivation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_AccountPathsMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Login</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TweetChoice</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Gateway_TweetMerge</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CompleteRegistration</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_ProvidePaymentInformation</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>End_TicketReceived</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
      <bpmn:lane id="Lane_USISystem" name="Sports institute system">
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_CheckSlotAvailability</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_TellCoursesAndDates</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_Tweet</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
        <bpmn:flowNodeRef>Task_IssueTicket</bpmn:flowNodeRef>
      </bpmn:lane>
    </bpmn:laneSet>

    <bpmn:startEvent id="Start_Registration" name="Course registration initiated"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_CheckSlotAvailability" name="Check course slot availability"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_SlotsAvailable" name="Are slots free?" default="Flow_NoSlots"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_NoSlots" name="No course slots available"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_TellCoursesAndDates" name="Tell applicant available courses and dates"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_SelectCourse" name="Select a course"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckAccount" name="Check whether an account exists"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountExists" name="Does an account exist?" default="Flow_NoAccount"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CheckEligibleUniversity" name="Check eligible university registration"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_EligibleUniversity" name="Registered at an eligible university?" default="Flow_NotEligible"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RegisterAccount" name="Register account"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_RequestActivation" name="Request activation"/>
    <bpmn:receiveTask id="Task_WaitForActivation" name="Wait for activation response"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_AccountPathsMerge" name="Account available"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_Login" name="Log into account"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TweetChoice" name="Tweet to friends?" default="Flow_SkipTweet"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_Tweet" name="Tweet to friends"/>
    <bpmn:exclusiveGateway id="Gateway_TweetMerge" name="Continue registration"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_CompleteRegistration" name="Complete course registration"/>
    <bpmn:userTask id="Task_ProvidePaymentInformation" name="Provide payment information"/>
    <bpmn:serviceTask id="Task_IssueTicket" name="Issue course ticket"/>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="End_TicketReceived" name="Course ticket received"/>

    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Start_CheckSlots" sourceRef="Start_Registration" targetRef="Task_CheckSlotAvailability"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckSlots_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckSlotAvailability" targetRef="Gateway_SlotsAvailable"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SlotsAvailable" name="Slots are free" sourceRef="Gateway_SlotsAvailable" targetRef="Task_TellCoursesAndDates">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">slotsAvailable</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoSlots" name="No slots are free" sourceRef="Gateway_SlotsAvailable" targetRef="End_NoSlots"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tell_Select" sourceRef="Task_TellCoursesAndDates" targetRef="Task_SelectCourse"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Select_CheckAccount" sourceRef="Task_SelectCourse" targetRef="Task_CheckAccount"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckAccount_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountExists"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AccountExists" name="Account exists" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountExists" targetRef="Gateway_AccountPathsMerge">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">accountExists</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NoAccount" name="No account" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountExists" targetRef="Task_CheckEligibleUniversity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CheckUniversity_Gateway" sourceRef="Task_CheckEligibleUniversity" targetRef="Gateway_EligibleUniversity"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Eligible" name="Registered at an eligible university" sourceRef="Gateway_EligibleUniversity" targetRef="Task_RegisterAccount">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">eligibleUniversity</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_NotEligible" name="Not registered at an eligible university" sourceRef="Gateway_EligibleUniversity" targetRef="Task_RequestActivation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_RegisterAccount_Merge" sourceRef="Task_RegisterAccount" targetRef="Gateway_AccountPathsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Request_Wait" sourceRef="Task_RequestActivation" targetRef="Task_WaitForActivation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Wait_Merge" sourceRef="Task_WaitForActivation" targetRef="Gateway_AccountPathsMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Merge_Login" sourceRef="Gateway_AccountPathsMerge" targetRef="Task_Login"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Login_TweetChoice" sourceRef="Task_Login" targetRef="Gateway_TweetChoice"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tweet" name="Tweet" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetChoice" targetRef="Task_Tweet">
      <bpmn:conditionExpression xsi:type="bpmn:tFormalExpression">tweetToFriends</bpmn:conditionExpression>
    </bpmn:sequenceFlow>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_SkipTweet" name="Do not tweet" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetChoice" targetRef="Gateway_TweetMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Tweet_Merge" sourceRef="Task_Tweet" targetRef="Gateway_TweetMerge"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TweetMerge_Complete" sourceRef="Gateway_TweetMerge" targetRef="Task_CompleteRegistration"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Complete_Payment" sourceRef="Task_CompleteRegistration" targetRef="Task_ProvidePaymentInformation"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Payment_Ticket" sourceRef="Task_ProvidePaymentInformation" targetRef="Task_IssueTicket"/>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_Ticket_End" sourceRef="Task_IssueTicket" targetRef="End_TicketReceived"/>
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
